item.description: Learn how to create a Django project and app in clear, guided steps. Use it as a reference for any future Django project and tutorial you'll work on.

item.title: The Real Python Podcast – Episode #280: Considering Fast and Slow in Python Programming
item.description: How often have you heard about the speed of Python? What's actually being measured, where are the bottlenecks---development time or run time---and which matters more for productivity? Christopher Trudeau is back on the show this week, bringing another batch of PyCoder's Weekly articles and projects.
